# PSScriptAnalyzer baseline for scripts/verify/psa-gate.ps1 (quality.yml powershell-lint).
# One line per tolerated legacy condition: "<path>|<rule>|<count>" tolerates exactly
# <count> Error-severity occurrences of that rule in that file (a missing count means 1;
# one more occurrence fails the job with its line number), "<path>|analyzer-exception"
# tolerates a file PSScriptAnalyzer 1.25.0 cannot analyze (every one of those uses
# `Export-ModuleMember -Class`, a parameter the cmdlet does not have). Anything not
# listed here fails the job. Repairing a finding? Lower the count or delete the line —
# the gate prints a notice when a line tolerates more than the file still trips. Adding
# new lines or raising a count for new code is not allowed; fix the finding instead.
scripts/optimization/check-integration-health.ps1|PSAvoidAssignmentToAutomaticVariable
scripts/microsoft-enterprise/azure/vm-orchestrator.ps1|PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText|4
